title: Puka Nacua: Not being out on practice field never crossed my mind

sources.name: Yahoo Sports NFL
sources.title: Puka Nacua: Not being out on practice field never crossed my mind
sources.description: After catching 313 passes over his first three NFL seasons, it looked like Rams wide receiver Puka Nacua was on the fast track toward a contract extension but off-field issues slowed things down this offseason.
